issuer: the Direção Nacional de Transportes Terrestres (DNTT)
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Direção Nacional de Transportes Terrestres (DNTT)'s own page on the driving licence (Karta Kondusaun, in Tetum): its Departamento Título de Condução issues the carta de condução under Decreto-Lei 6/2003 (the Código da Estrada) after the theory, oral and practical tests; the minimum age for categories A, B and B+E is 18 (16 for A1, 21 for C and D); minors must file a declaration and request for the DNTT Director's approval (no age is given for that, and it isn't held); the card is given 'original' for two years ('durasaun tinan rua ba kartaun original') or provisional for six months or a year, so the full card is held as two years (a reading of the Tetum). Fee: Decreto-Lei 17/2026 of 6 May 2026 (Jornal da República, Série I, No. 18, as the DNTT posts it), Annex II, issuing a carta de condução US$28 for every category (the theory and practical examination, US$21 for light vehicles, and the licença de condução provisória/permanente, US$14, aren't held). The DNTT verifies a foreign licence for a Timorese one after theory and practical tests, so no exchange list is held. No identity card is the DNTT's.

sources.title: Karta Kondusaun (Direção Nacional de Transportes Terrestres, Timor-Leste)
sources.said: Atribui/ fo karta kondusaun bazeia ba Dekretu Lei Nu.6/2003-Kodigu Estrada ... Kategoria A, B e B+E: 18 anos; ... Ba sira nebe idade sei minoria tenki halo deklarasaun ho pedidu hodi submete iha DNTT hodi hetan aprovasaun husi Diretora DNTT. ... Fo karta kondusaun original/provizoriu ho durasaun tinan rua ba kartaun original, fulan 6 no tinan ida ba kartaun provizoriu.
